v.s: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
v.c: Successful indeed are the believers:

v.s: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
v.c: those who humble themselves in prayer;

q: (talk and acts that have no benefit)...
v.s: And they who turn away from ill speech
v.c: those who avoid idle talk;

q: ...who fulfil the act of paying zakaah
(punctually and happily to purify the heart, body and wealth)...
v.s: And they who are observant of zakāh
v.c: those who pay alms-tax;

q: (from adultery, fornication and other illicit sexual acts)...
v.s: And they who guard their private parts
v.c: those who guard their chastity

q: ...except when it comes to their spouses and the slave women whom they own. They will surely not be blamed about
v.s: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
v.c: except with their wives or those ˹bondwomen˺ in their possession, for then they are free from blame,

q: (by fulfilling their sexual desires in a manner that the Shari'ah forbids),
v.s: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
v.c: but whoever seeks beyond that are the transgressors;

q: Those who give due regard to
(taking every precaution to fulfil the pledges and promises they make to Allaah and to people)...
v.s: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
v.c: ˹the believers are also˺ those who are true to their trusts and covenants;

q: (ensuring that their salaah is performed on time and with all the necessary requisites and etiquette).
v.s: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
v.c: and those who are ˹properly˺ observant of their prayers.

v.s: Those are the inheritors
v.c: These are the ones who will be awarded

v.s: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
v.c: Paradise as their own. They will be there forever.

v.s: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
v.c: And indeed, We created humankind from an extract of clay,

q: (when mankind arrived on earth, the system of reproduction started and the development of a child began when)
We placed him in a safe lodging
v.s: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
v.c: then placed each ˹human˺ as a sperm-drop in a secure place,

q: Thereafter, We made the drop of fluid into a clot of blood, then the clot of blood into a lump of flesh, then the lump of flesh into bones, after which We dressed the bones in flesh. Thereafter
(when We instilled the soul into the foetus)
We made him into another type of creation
So Blessed is Allaah, the Best of all creators
(no other being can make something from nothing or give life to anything they make).
v.s: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is God, the best of creators.
v.c: then We developed the drop into a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then developed the clot into a lump ˹of flesh˺, then developed the lump into bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, then We brought it into being as a new creation. So Blessed is Allah, the Best of Creators.

q: (after coming into the world and spending your lives in this world)
v.s: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
v.c: After that you will surely die,

q: you will surely be resurrected on the Day of Qiyaamah.
v.s: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
v.c: then on the Day of Judgment you will be resurrected.

q: We have certainly created seven paths
above you and we are never unaware of the creation
(We know the condition of everything We created and provide for and protect everything).
v.s: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
v.c: And indeed, We created above you seven levels ˹of heaven˺. We are never unmindful of ˹Our˺ creation.

m: then We cause it to settle
q: We send stipulated quantities of water from the skies, embedding it into the earth
(irrigating the roots of plants and storing underground water),
and We are also capable of withdrawing it
(whenever We wish, after which no other being can retrieve it).
v.s: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
v.c: We send down rain from the sky in perfect measure, causing it to soak into the earth. And We are surely able to take it away.

q: We create for you orchards of date palms and grapes
(the orchards of date palms and grapes)
is an abundance of fruit for you, from which you eat
(together with eating from it, you also feed your families and animals, and you can also gain from selling the fruit).
v.s: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
v.c: With it We produce for you gardens of palm trees and grapevines, in which there are abundant fruits, and from which you may eat,

q: that grows from Mount Sinai, bearing oil
(for burning in lamps and for medicinal uses)
(it is also used for cooking, producing an excellent)
gravy for those who wish to eat
v.s: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.
v.c: as well as ˹olive˺ trees which grow at Mount Sinai, providing oil and a condiment to eat.

q: There is certainly a lesson for you in the animals
from their bellies, there are many benefits for you in them
(such as using them for transport, for carrying goods, for ploughing fields, etc),
and you even eat of them.
v.s: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
v.c: And there is certainly a lesson for you in cattle, from whose bellies We give you ˹milk˺ to drink, and in them are many other benefits for you, and from them you may eat.

q: You are even carried on them
v.s: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
v.c: And you are carried upon ˹some of˺ them and upon ships.

q: We sent Nooh ﵊ to his nation and he told them, “O my people! Worship only Allaah. There is no Ilaah for you besides Him. Do you not fear
v.s: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship God; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
v.c: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people. He declared, “O my people! Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”

q: is only a human like yourselves who intends to gain superiority over you
he would have rather sent angels
We have never heard of such a thing
v.s: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if God had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
v.c: But the disbelieving chiefs of his people said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you, who wants to be superior to you. Had Allah willed, He could have easily sent down angels ˹instead˺. We have never heard of this in ˹the history of˺ our forefathers.

q: “He is but a man afflicted by insanity
So bear with him a while longer
(until he dies, when we will be rid of him).”
v.s: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
v.c: He is simply insane, so bear with him for a while.”

q: (After preaching to his people for 950 years without a favour able response from them)
Nooh ﵊ said, “O my Rabb! Assist me
v.s: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
v.c: Noah prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”

q: So We sent revelation to him saying, “Construct an ark under Our supervision and revelation. When Our command
comes and water gushes forth from the earth
(as a sign of the punishment coming),
then enter into the ark a pair of every species
except those against whom the decree
And do not speak to me about those who oppress
(do not ask me to save those who commit kufr).
v.s: So We inspired to him, “Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
v.c: So We inspired him: “Build the Ark under Our ˹watchful˺ Eyes and directions. Then when Our command comes and the oven bursts ˹with water˺, take on board a pair from every species along with your family —except those against whom the decree ˹to drown˺ has already been passed. And do not plead with Me for those who have done wrong, for they will surely be drowned.”

q: “When you and those with you have boarded the ark, then say
'All praise be to Allaah, Who has rescued us from the oppressive
v.s: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, ‘Praise to God who has saved us form the wrongdoing people.’
v.c: Then when you and those with you have settled in the Ark, say, “All praise is for Allah, Who saved us from the wrongdoing people.”

q: “And say, 'O my Rabb! Settle me in a blessed place. You are surely the Best of hosts.”
(Bless us at all times with Your mercy.)
v.s: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"
v.c: And pray, “My Lord! Allow me a blessed landing, for You are the best accommodator.”

q: and We certainly put people to the test
(to separate the good from the evil).
v.s: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
v.c: Surely in this are lessons. And We ˹always˺ put ˹people˺ to the test.

q: We created another nation after them
v.s: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
v.c: Then We raised another generation after them,

q: “Worship only Allaah. There is no Ilaah for you besides Him. Do you not fear
(His punishment if you do not accept Imaan)?”
v.s: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship God; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
v.c: and sent to them a messenger from among themselves, ˹declaring,˺ “Worship Allah ˹alone˺. You have no god other than Him. Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”

m: while We had given them luxury
q: The Kuffaar leaders from his nation, who denied the meeting of the Aakhirah and to whom We had granted affluence
is merely a human like yourselves who eats what you eat and drinks what you drink
(there is nothing special about him that makes him worthy of being followed).”
v.s: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
v.c: But the chiefs of his people—who disbelieved, denied the meeting ˹with Allah˺ in the Hereafter, and were spoiled by the worldly luxuries We had provided for them—said ˹to the masses˺, “This is only a human like you. He eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink.

q: like yourselves, you will certainly be at a loss
v.s: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
v.c: And if you ˹ever˺ obey a human like yourselves, then you would certainly be losers.

q: “Does he promise you that you will be resurrected
after you have died and become dust and bones?”
v.s: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
v.c: Does he promise you that once you are dead and reduced to dust and bones, you will be brought forth ˹alive˺?

q: is that which you are promised!
v.s: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
v.c: Impossible, simply impossible is what you are promised!

q: “This is but our worldly existence. We die and live, and will never be raised up again
v.s: It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
v.c: There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die, others are born, and none will be resurrected.

q: “He is only a man who invents lies against Allaah
(by saying that Allaah sends revelation to him),
and we shall never believe him.”
v.s: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about God, and we will not believe him."
v.c: He is no more than a man who has fabricated a lie about Allah, and we will never believe in him.”

v.s: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
v.c: The messenger prayed, “My Lord! Help me, because they have denied ˹me˺.”

q: Allaah said, “Shortly these people will regret
(their behaviour when My punishment afflicts them).”
v.s: [God] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
v.c: Allah responded, “Soon they will be truly regretful.”

q: So, according to the true promise, a dreadful scream
seized them and We reduced them to nothing. May the oppressive
v.s: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
v.c: Then the ˹mighty˺ blast overtook them with justice, and We reduced them to rubble. So away with the wrongdoing people!

q: (such as the people of Madyan, the people of)
v.s: Then We produced after them other generations.
v.c: Then We raised other generations after them.

q: No nation can outstrip their term
(they cannot survive beyond the time when they are destined to perish),
v.s: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
v.c: No people can advance their doom, nor can they delay it.

q: Thereafter We sent Our Rusul in succession. Whenever a Rasool came to his nation
they rejected him. So We brought one nation after the other
May the nations without Imaan be distanced
v.s: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
v.c: Then We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to his people, they denied him. So We destroyed them, one after the other, reducing them to ˹cautionary˺ tales. So away with the people who refuse to believe!

q: We then sent Moosa ﵊ and his brother Haaroon ﵊ with Our Aayaat and a manifest proof
(to prove that they were indeed Allaah's messengers).
v.s: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
v.c: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and compelling proof

v.s: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
v.c: to Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they behaved arrogantly and were a tyrannical people.

q: They said, “Should we believe in two humans like ourselves whereas their people
v.s: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
v.c: They argued, “Will we believe in two humans, like ourselves, whose people are slaves to us?”

q: So they rejected the two of them and
v.s: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
v.c: So they rejected them both, and ˹so˺ were among those destroyed.

q: We had certainly granted Moosa ﵊ the Book
v.s: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
v.c: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so perhaps his people would be ˹rightly˺ guided.

q: And We made the son of Maryam
(to demonstrate Our power and to prove that We can do things without means)
and settled them on such a hill that was habitable and had water
(either Damascus, Baytul Maqdas or Rama Ia).
v.s: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
v.c: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and gave them refuge on high ground—a ˹suitable˺ place for rest with flowing water.

q: “O you Rusul! Eat from the pure
(in gratitude to Me for My provision)
Verily I am Aware of what you do
(and will reward you for every good act).” (Although addressed directly to the Ambiyaa ﵊, this command applies to the followers of the Ambiyaa ﵊ as well.)
v.s: [God said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.
v.c: O messengers! Eat from what is good and lawful, and act righteously. Indeed, I fully know what you do.

q: (the lives you lead in obedience to Me)
and I am your Rabb, so fear Me
(only).” (Do not fear others who wish to deviate you from this way of life.)
v.s: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
v.c: Surely this religion of yours is ˹only˺ one, and I am your Lord, so fear Me ˹alone˺.

q: (instead of following the single clear way of their Ambiyaa ﵊)
split their affairs between themselves into segments
(In this manner, they refused to unite and split into many religious denominations, each one thinking that they are on the right path.)
v.s: But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
v.c: Yet the people have divided it into different sects, each rejoicing in what they have.

q: (do not be distressed about their condition, but)
(because they will realise the error of their ways when they leave this world).
v.s: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
v.c: So leave them ˹O Prophet˺ in their heedlessness for a while.

q: (When they see their prosperity in this world,)
think that by Us granting them an increase in wealth and sons...
v.s: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
v.c: Do they think, since We provide them with wealth and children,

q: ...We wish to hasten in granting them good? No

(that an increase in material possessions does not mean that We are pleased with them. We are merely granting them time to involve themselves in more sin so that they become deserving of more punishment).
v.s: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
v.c: that We hasten to ˹honour˺ them ˹with˺ all kinds of good? No! They are not aware.

q: Verily those who are fearful of their Rabb...
v.s: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
v.c: Surely those who tremble in awe of their Lord,

q: ...those who believe in the Aayaat of their Rabb...
v.s: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
v.c: and who believe in the revelations of their Lord,

q: ...those who do not ascribe partners to their Rabb
v.s: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
v.c: and who associate none with their Lord,

q: because they have to return to their Rabb
(when it will be known whether their deeds are accepted or not)...
v.s: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
v.c: and who do whatever ˹good˺ they do with their hearts fearful, ˹knowing˺ that they will return to their Lord—

q: ...these people hasten to perform good acts and are the foremost in it
v.s: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
v.c: it is they who race to do good deeds, always taking the lead.

q: (Doing good deeds is not difficult for people because)
Allaah does not place on a soul a responsibility
except what is within its capability. We have by Us a Book
that speaks the truth, and they will not be oppressed
(they will be punished only for the sins they committed and will not be deprived of the reward for any good deeds).
v.s: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
v.c: We never require of any soul more than what it can afford. And with Us is a record which speaks the truth. None will be wronged.

q: acts that they carry out besides this
(besides their ignorance and doubts). (They therefore have a great deal to answer for.)
v.s: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,
v.c: But the hearts of those ˹who disbelieve˺ are oblivious to ˹all of˺ this, and they have other ˹evil˺ deeds, opposite to this, in which they are engrossed.

q: (These people will remain engrossed in their kufr and Shirk)
Until the time comes when We will seize the affluent ones among them with punishment, they will suddenly plead
v.s: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to God] for help.
v.c: But as soon as We seize their elite with torment, they start to cry for help.

q: (Allaah will then instruct the angels to tell them)
“Do not plead today! You will receive no help
v.s: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
v.c: ˹They will be told,˺ “Do not cry for help today. Surely you will never be saved from Us.

q: “My Aayaat used to be recited to you, but
v.s: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels.
v.c: Indeed, My revelations were recited to you, but you used to back away ˹in disgust˺,

q: (not wanting to have anything to do with it).”
v.s: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
v.c: boasting of the Sacred House, and babbling ˹nonsense about the Quran˺ by night.”

q: Have they not pondered over this speech
(the Qur'aan because of which they do not want to accept it),
(they refuse to accept it because they say that)
such a thing has come to them that never came to their forefathers?
v.s: Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
v.c: Is it because they have never contemplated the Word ˹of Allah˺? Or ˹because˺ there has come to them something that did not come to their forefathers?

q: not recognised their Rasool, causing them to reject him?
v.s: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
v.c: Or ˹because˺ they failed to recognize their Messenger, and so they denied him?

q: (none of the above are reasons for their rejection),
has brought the truth to them and most of them dislike
v.s: Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
v.c: Or ˹because˺ they say, “He is insane?” In fact, he has come to them with the truth, but most of them are resentful of the truth.

q: (wishes), (it would make Allaah so angry that)
the heavens, earth and all within the two would be corrupted
However, We have brought their advice
to them but they ignore the advice given to them.
v.s: But if the Truth [i.e., God] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
v.c: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens, the earth, and all those in them would have certainly been corrupted. In fact, We have brought them ˹the means to˺ their glory, but they turn away from it.

q: (and they; find it difficult to pay you)? (This reason if assumed to be true is foolish because)
The payment of your Rabb is best and He is the Best of Providers
(why then would anyone prefer their own payment to that of Allaah's?).
v.s: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
v.c: Or ˹is it because˺ you ˹O Prophet˺ are asking them for tribute? But the reward of your Lord is best, for He is the Best Provider.

q: call them to the straight path.
v.s: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
v.c: And surely you are calling them to the Straight Path,

q: Those who do not believe in the Aakhirah are certainly deviated
(because they do not seek salvation in the Aakhirah).
v.s: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
v.c: but those who disbelieve in the Hereafter are certainly deviating from that Path.

q: (Let alone rejecting the Aayaat of Allaah, these people are so lost that they even fail to mend their ways when adversities strike. Furthermore,)
If We have mercy on them and remove their adversities
(difficulties), (instead of being grateful to Allaah and believing in Him,)
they will blindly plunge back into their rebellion
v.s: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
v.c: ˹Even˺ if We had mercy on them and removed their affliction, they would still persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

q: We have surely afflicted them with punishment, but they do not submit to their Rabb, nor have they humbled themselves.
(There does not seem to be nothing that will bring them to the straight path.)
v.s: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
v.c: And We have already seized them with torment, but they never humbled themselves to their Lord, nor did they ˹submissively˺ appeal ˹to Him˺.

q: (either in this world or in the Aakhirah)
We shall open for them a door of severe punishment and they will be left totally bewildered
(and without hope, but it will then be too late to repent).
v.s: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
v.c: But as soon as We open for them a gate of severe punishment, they will be utterly desperate.

q: Allaah is the One Who created your ears, eyes and hearts. Seldom is it that you show gratitude
(for these and millions of other favours that He has given you).
v.s: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
v.c: He is the One Who created for you hearing, sight, and intellect. ˹Yet˺ you hardly give any thanks.

q: (each one having his own area to live),
and to Him shall you be resurrected
(on the Day of Qiyaamah when He will question you about how you used the favours He gave you).
v.s: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
v.c: And He is the One Who has dispersed you ˹all˺ over the earth, and to Him you will ˹all˺ be gathered.

q: It is He Who gives life and death and it is only because of Him that the night and day alternate. Do you not understand
(that Allaah possesses all these powers and is most certainly capable of bringing man back to life)?
v.s: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
v.c: And He is the One Who gives life and causes death, and to Him belongs the alternation of the day and night. Will you not then understand?

q: (instead of realising that it is so easy for Allaah to bring the dead back to life)
v.s: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
v.c: But they ˹just˺ say what their predecessors said.

q: They say, “Will we be raised after we have died and become dust and bones?”
v.s: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
v.c: They said, “Once we are dead and reduced to dust and bones, will we really be resurrected?

q: “Our forefathers and ourselves were certainly promised the same from before. It
v.s: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
v.c: We have already been promised this, as well as our forefathers earlier. This is nothing but ancient fables!”

q: Say, “To whom belongs the earth and whoever is on it, if you know
(who is the Creator of all of this)?”
v.s: Say, [O Muhammad], “To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?”
v.c: Ask ˹them, O Prophet˺, “To whom belong the earth and all those on it, if you ˹really˺ know?”

q: will soon reply, It all belongs to Allaah
Say, “Will you then not take heed
(can you then not understand that since Allaah has the power to create all of this, He most certainly has the power to create them a second time)?”
v.s: They will say, "To God." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
v.c: They will reply, “To Allah!” Say, “Why are you not then mindful?”

q: Say, “Who is the Rabb of the seven heavens and the tremendous Throne
v.s: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
v.c: ˹And˺ ask ˹them˺, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Mighty Throne?”

q: They will shortly reply, “It all belongs to Allaah.” Say, “Will you then not
v.s: They will say, "[They belong] to God." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
v.c: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “Will you not then fear ˹Him˺?”

q: Say, “In whose grasp is the control of all things? Who is it that can offer protection
while none can provide protection against Him
v.s: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
v.c: Ask ˹them also,˺ “In Whose Hands is the authority over all things, protecting ˹all˺ while none can protect against Him, if you ˹really˺ know?”

q: they will say, “It all belongs to Allaah
Say, “How then have you been bewitched?”
(Despite realising all of this, the only reason for your Shirk must be that you have been afflicted by magic.)
v.s: They will say, "[All belongs] to God." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
v.c: They will reply, “Allah.” Say, “How are you then so deluded?”

q: (via the Ambiyaa ﵊ and the divine scriptures),
(for denying that they were told these things).
v.s: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
v.c: In fact, We have brought them the truth, and they are certainly liars.

q: Allaah has not taken any son, nor are there any Aaliha
then every Ilaah would have separated his creation
(so that only he should have control over them)
and some would overpower the others

(in the fight for supremacy. This would have resulted in the system of the universe being reduced to chaos. However, since the universe is functioning smoothly, it follows that such a scenario did not occur).
Allaah is Pure of the partners that they ascribe to Him
(Only He is in control and is therefore the only One worthy of worship).
v.s: God has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have [sought to] overcome others. Exalted is God above what they describe [concerning Him].
v.c: Allah has never had ˹any˺ offspring, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what he created, and they would have tried to dominate one another. Glorified is Allah above what they claim!

q: Allaah is the Knower of the unseen and the seen, so He is Exalted above the partners that they ascribe
(because all of these “partners” have no such knowledge whatsoever).
v.s: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
v.c: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the seen and unseen. Exalted is He above what they associate ˹with Him˺.

q: Say, “O my Rabb! If you happen to show me what
v.s: Say, [O Muhammad], “My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Should You show me what they are threatened with,

q: “...then, O my Rabb, do not include me among the oppressive folk
(the Kuffaar. Do not make me suffer the same punishment).'
v.s: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
v.c: then, my Lord, do not count me among the wrongdoing people.”

q: We are certainly capable of showing you what
(they can well suffer punishment during your lifetime).
v.s: And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them.
v.c: We are indeed able to show you what We have threatened them with.

q: (by forgiving them and being good to them).
We know best what they ascribe
(what they say and do and We shall therefore punish them appropriately).
v.s: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
v.c: Respond to evil with what is best. We know well what they claim.

q: And say, “O my Rabb! I seek Your protection
from the evil whispering of the Shayaateen...”
v.s: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
v.c: And say, “My Lord! I seek refuge in You from the temptations of the devils.

q: “...and, O my Rabb, I seek protection from You that
(always try to tempt me with evil).”
v.s: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
v.c: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, that they ˹even˺ come near me.”

q: (The Kuffaar continue practising kufr and behaving stubbornly)
Until the time arrives when death comes to any one of them, then
(when he sees the punishment in store for him)
he says, “O my Rabb! Allow me to return
v.s: [For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
v.c: When death approaches any of them, they cry, “My Lord! Let me go back,

q: “...so that I may perform good deeds in that
which I have left behind.” Never
(they will never do as they say)!
is merely a statement that they speak
(an empty). (They will be unable to return to the world because)
(a barrier preventing their return, which will remain in place)
until the day that they are resurrected
v.s: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
v.c: so I may do good in what I left behind.” Never! It is only a ˹useless˺ appeal they make. And there is a barrier behind them until the Day they are resurrected.

q: neither shall there be any family ties between them
(each person will disassociate from his/her relatives fearing that their relatives may ask them for rewards, which they so desperately need for themselves),
(because each person will worry only about himself).
v.s: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
v.c: Then, when the Trumpet will be blown, there will be no kinship between them on that Day, nor will they ˹even care to˺ ask about one another.

q: (with good deeds on the Day of Qiyaamah)
v.s: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
v.c: As for those whose scale is heavy ˹with good deeds˺, it is they who will be successful.

q: (lacking in good deeds and heavy with sins),
these are the ones who have put themselves
at a loss and shall remain forever in Jahannam.
v.s: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
v.c: But those whose scale is light, they will have doomed themselves, staying in Hell forever.

q: will scorch their faces and they shall be disfigured there.
v.s: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
v.c: The Fire will burn their faces, leaving them deformed.

q: (Allaah will then instruct the angels to say to them,)
v.s: [It will be said], "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
v.c: ˹It will be said,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, but you used to deny them?”

q: (We admit that we were at fault because)
overpowered us and we were a deviated nation.”
v.s: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
v.c: They will cry, “Our Lord! Our ill-fate took hold of us, so we became a misguided people.

q: “O our Rabb! Remove us from here
(by doing what we did previously in the world),
then we must surely be oppressors
v.s: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
v.c: Our Lord! Take us out of this ˹Fire˺. Then if we ever return ˹to denial˺, we will truly be wrongdoers.”

q: and do not speak to Me
v.s: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
v.c: Allah will respond, “Be despised in there! Do not ˹ever˺ plead with Me ˹again˺!

q: There was a party of My bondsmen
who used to say, 'O our Rabb! We have Imaan, so forgive us and have mercy on us. Indeed You are the Best of those who show mercy.“'
v.s: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
v.c: Indeed, there was a group of My servants who used to pray, ‘Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive us and have mercy on us, for You are the best of those who show mercy,’

v.s: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
v.c: but you were ˹so busy˺ making fun of them that it made you forget My remembrance. And you used to laugh at them.

q: “(However, they had patiently borne your taunts and)
I have rewarded them today for their patience;
(and will therefore enter Jannah where they will live forever).”
v.s: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
v.c: Today I have indeed rewarded them for their perseverance: they are certainly the triumphant.”

q: “How long did you stay on earth by the count of
v.s: [God] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
v.c: He will ask ˹them˺, “How many years did you remain on earth?”

q: “(Years are far too long to use as a measure. More appropriately, we will say that)
We stayed only a day or a part of a day, but
(the angels who were recording our lives).
v.s: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
v.c: They will reply, “We remained ˹only˺ a day or part of a day. But ask those who kept count.”

q: “(Although not a day or a part of a day, the fact is certain that)
You stayed only for a little while. If only you had known
(this while living in the world, then you would not have wasted your precious time).”
v.s: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
v.c: He will say, “You only remained for a little while, if only you knew.

q: Did you think that We had created you in vain
and that you would not return to Us
(to answer for what you did in the world)?”
v.s: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
v.c: Did you then think that We had created you without purpose, and that you would never be returned to Us?”

q: Exalted is Allaah, the Sovereign, the Truth
There is no Ilaah but He. He is the Rabb of the Glorious Throne.
v.s: So exalted is God, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
v.c: Exalted is Allah, the True King! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him, the Lord of the Honourable Throne.

q: another Ilaah with Allaah has no proof for it
The fact of the matter is that
v.s: And whoever invokes besides God another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
v.c: Whoever invokes, besides Allah, another god—for which they can have no proof—they will surely find their penalty with their Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will never succeed.

q: Undoubtedly, You are the Best of those who show mercy.”
v.s: And, [O Muhammad], say, “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.”
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the best of those who show mercy.”
